name: Fair Comparison Invalid Area Metric
physical_basis: Area alone does not capture logistics duty, charging burden, thermal interface intensity or service complexity.
operational_basis: Cross-dock, storage, fulfillment and cold-chain nodes can share area but differ radically in throughput, schedule and conditioning duty.
financial_mechanism: Using the wrong denominator can distort valuation, underwriting and retrofit sequencing.
typical_false_assumption: EUI per square foot is a fair default for any warehouse-like asset.
hypothesis: Area-based comparison may be conceptually invalid until service intensity and duty boundaries are normalized.
rival_hypotheses: area is still a fair primary denominator
missing dimensions are not materially comparison-defining
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: multiple critical comparison dimensions remain unbounded
falsification_conditions: required comparison dimensions are sufficiently bounded to support a fair peer set
allowed_claim_language: Fair comparison is not yet valid until the comparison basis is normalized.
prohibited_claim_language: This asset is inefficient compared to peers.
financial_exposure_if_false: peer comparison may become admissible once normalization is complete
stop_conditions: fair peer set can be built with normalized dimensions
escalation_conditions: operator input required if key service-level dimensions remain unavailable publicly
example_outputs: Area may be the wrong denominator until service-level intensity and charging profile are bounded.
tests: warehouse acceptance bundle should block generic peer framing when key dimensions are missing
no superiority claim allowed while comparison remains invalid
